projects.title: Campus Event & Workshop Finder
projects.subtitle: Hackathon 1st Place Winning Project
projects.description: Web app for university students to discover, RSVP, and receive notifications for campus technical workshops and hackathons.
projects.longDescription: Built during 24-hour campus hackathon and won 1st place. Implemented interactive map view, registration forms, and calendar syncing.
highlights: Awarded 1st Place among 40 participating university teams.
Built responsive frontend UI in under 24 hours with live Firebase real-time database.

projects.title: Algorithm Visualizer & Comparator
projects.subtitle: Interactive Computer Science Learning Tool
projects.description: Interactive web tool visually animating sorting and searching algorithms to help fellow students learn DSA concepts.
projects.longDescription: Created to demonstrate sorting algorithms (Bubble, Merge, Quick Sort) with step-by-step speed controls and execution time comparisons.
highlights: Used by 200+ class students during DSA course revision.
Implemented smooth canvas animations without external graphical dependencies.

achievements: Mentored 60+ junior students in basic programming and Git version control.
